steps.note: Open the Single Stage event creation screen.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation as required by the case.
Set the event type to RFQ and use the entire-lot awarding mode.
Apply an RFQ pricing template so the product sheet is available.
Add the specified product; the product's configured variant should populate automatically.
Fill remaining mandatory pricing-sheet fields so the event can be completed.
Set the first line item's requested quantity to 10.
Verify that Quantity Requested remains 10 after editing and tabbing away.
Provide a price so Total Amount can be calculated.
Verify that Total Amount is calculated as price 100 multiplied by quantity 10.
Add the named vendor to the event participants.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
